features.name: Execution model

values.workflow: Durable JS functions with event-sourced replay (node:vm sandbox + SWC-split step bundles)
values.gh-aw: Markdown with YAML frontmatter compiled to GitHub Actions .lock.yml; agent interprets NL body

features.delta: Entirely different paradigms: typed durable code vs declarative NL DSL compiled to CI jobs.

features.name: Primary runtime

values.workflow: Node.js on Vercel / self-host (Postgres/local FS)
values.gh-aw: GitHub Actions runners

features.delta: Runtime substrates share almost no assumptions.

features.name: Author surface

values.workflow: TypeScript / JavaScript source files with "use workflow" / "use step" directives
values.gh-aw: Markdown + YAML frontmatter; body is natural-language prompt

features.delta: Code vs prose DSL.

features.name: Step persistence

values.workflow: Every step input/output persisted to event log (core engine + world backends)
values.gh-aw: Persistence is Actions-level: job logs + artifacts; no per-LLM-turn event log

features.delta: workflow has a first-class durable step abstraction; gh-aw inherits Actions semantics.

features.name: Crash recovery

values.workflow: Deterministic replay reconstructs state after cold start/scale event (docs: event-sourcing.mdx)
values.gh-aw: Replay = re-run the GitHub Actions workflow_run (workflow-level, not step-level)

features.delta: workflow recovers mid-function; gh-aw recovers by restarting the whole workflow_run.

features.name: Exactly-once side effects

values.workflow: Steps memoized by event log; author warned to keep step bodies idempotent (foundations/idempotency.mdx)
values.gh-aw: No framework-level memoization; responsibility sits in action implementations (safe-outputs handler has dedupe)

features.delta: Both rely on user-level idempotency, but workflow structurally memoizes successful steps.

features.name: Default retries

values.workflow: 3 retries per step by default; `fn.maxRetries = N` override (docs: errors-and-retries.mdx)
values.gh-aw: Inherits Actions `continue-on-error` / step-retry-action patterns; no framework default for LLM retries beyond `max-turns`/`max-continuations` knobs

features.delta: workflow has typed retry primitives; gh-aw delegates to Actions and per-engine knobs.

features.name: Typed error opt-outs

values.workflow: `FatalError` (stop) / `RetryableError` (custom retryAfter, arbitrary backoff) — packages/errors
values.gh-aw: No equivalent error taxonomy; engines may abort via max-turns

features.delta: Only workflow ships typed retry controls.

features.name: Backoff / jitter

values.workflow: Arbitrary user-supplied schedule: `retryAfter: (attempt ** 2) * 1000`; duration strings via ms (docs/foundations/errors-and-retries.mdx)
values.gh-aw: Delegated to Actions retry tooling

features.delta: workflow exposes programmable backoff; gh-aw depends on external action patterns.

features.name: Append-only event log

values.workflow: Yes — events-consumer.ts, per-world backend stores events (local FS / Postgres / Vercel)
values.gh-aw: No — Actions stores job logs; no per-step event stream

features.delta: workflow-only capability.

features.name: Deterministic replay

values.workflow: First-class — docs/how-it-works/event-sourcing.mdx; seedrandom + ULID ensure determinism
values.gh-aw: N/A — each workflow_run is independent

features.delta: workflow-only capability.

features.name: Observability UI

values.workflow: observability.ts hydrateResourceIO powers replay inspector (referenced in CLAUDE.md)
values.gh-aw: GitHub Actions run UI + `gh aw logs`

features.delta: Both have UIs; workflow's is step/event-aware, gh-aw's is job-aware.

features.name: Audit trail

values.workflow: Event log doubles as audit trail
values.gh-aw: GitHub Actions audit + repo commit history of .lock.yml + `gh aw audit` command

features.delta: Different shapes of auditability; both credible.

features.name: Fan-out primitive

values.workflow: `Promise.all` on step invocations runs them in parallel, all persisted (docs/foundations/common-patterns.mdx)
values.gh-aw: `matrix:` strategy in compiled Actions YAML (inherited); `engine.concurrency` caps per engine

features.delta: Both support parallelism, but workflow parallelizes inside one function; gh-aw relies on Actions matrix per job.

features.name: Race / timeout

values.workflow: `Promise.race` + durable sleep for timeouts
values.gh-aw: `timeout-minutes` on Actions jobs + stop-after triggers

features.delta: Conceptually similar outcomes via different mechanisms.

features.name: Concurrency limits

values.workflow: Not prominently documented at framework level; worlds can throttle
values.gh-aw: Dual concurrency: per-workflow keyed by issue/PR/branch + per-engine `gh-aw-{engine-id}`

features.delta: gh-aw ships richer concurrency-group controls out of the box.

features.name: Languages

values.workflow: JavaScript / TypeScript only
values.gh-aw: Markdown DSL; agent prompts can invoke any language via shell/tools; native CLI in Go

features.delta: gh-aw is polyglot at the tool surface; workflow is JS-only.

features.name: DSL richness

values.workflow: None — idiomatic TS (directives only)
values.gh-aw: Rich YAML frontmatter + NL body; dedicated reference docs: triggers, safe-outputs, tools, engines, sandbox, concurrency

features.delta: gh-aw has a large DSL; workflow deliberately has none.

features.name: Framework integrations

values.workflow: Next.js, Nitro, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, NestJS (6 packages)
values.gh-aw: N/A (runs on Actions)

features.delta: workflow-only category.

features.name: IDE support

values.workflow: TypeScript plugin package + TS types
values.gh-aw: WASM compiler for editor integration; schema-backed YAML

features.delta: Both invest in editor integration along the grain of their DSL.

features.name: Managed hosting

values.workflow: First-class on Vercel (world-vercel); other worlds (local/postgres) exist but less battle-tested
values.gh-aw: Runs anywhere GitHub Actions runs (GitHub.com, GHES, self-hosted runners)

features.delta: workflow leans Vercel; gh-aw leans GitHub — both are major vendors, but GitHub Actions is more widely self-hosted.

features.name: Self-host option

values.workflow: @workflow/world-postgres (Drizzle) + @workflow/world-local for dev
values.gh-aw: GitHub Actions self-hosted runners; same compiled .lock.yml

features.delta: Both self-hostable with trade-offs.

features.name: Portable artifact

values.workflow: npm packages; portable JS source
values.gh-aw: Standard GitHub Actions YAML (.lock.yml) — portable across GH repos/orgs

features.delta: Different artifacts; both portable within their ecosystems.

features.name: Vendor-neutral backend

values.workflow: World abstraction allows new backends; PR-friendly
values.gh-aw: Bound to GitHub Actions semantics; companion firewall/gateway are GitHub projects

features.delta: workflow abstracts storage; gh-aw assumes Actions.

features.name: Sandboxing

values.workflow: Workflow body runs in node:vm (determinism, not security)
values.gh-aw: AWF firewall (default), MCP Gateway, lockdown mode, tool allow-lists

features.delta: gh-aw explicitly targets adversarial safety; workflow's sandbox targets determinism.

features.name: Approval gates

values.workflow: Hooks can implement human-in-the-loop manually
values.gh-aw: `on.manual-approval` via GitHub Environments; skip-roles/skip-bots guards

features.delta: Both possible, gh-aw first-class.

features.name: Output validation

values.workflow: Return types / zod schemas if author chooses
values.gh-aw: Safe-outputs handler validates every side effect (comment/PR/issue/label)

features.delta: gh-aw enforces schema at write time by design.

features.name: Secret redaction

values.workflow: No built-in redaction layer
values.gh-aw: Built-in regex redactor for GitHub/Azure/Google/AWS/OpenAI/Anthropic keys

features.delta: gh-aw-only.

features.name: Supply-chain hardening

values.workflow: Standard npm; `pnpm.overrides` pin devalue/rfc6902
values.gh-aw: SHA-pinned Actions via pkg/actionpins + gosec + actionlint on compile

features.delta: Both invest; gh-aw is more automated/explicit.

features.name: Sample workflows

values.workflow: workbench/example + nextjs-turbopack demos
values.gh-aw: 272 sample workflows in .github/workflows/ (smoke + agentics)

features.delta: gh-aw ships vastly more example surface.

features.name: Community contributions

values.workflow: Vercel team-led, open-source; initial core engineers list
values.gh-aw: Large community contributor list auto-tracked in README (100+ named)

features.delta: gh-aw has more visible community traction today.

features.name: Skills for agent authoring

values.workflow: 3 skills (workflow, workflow-init, migrating-to-workflow-sdk)
values.gh-aw: 22 skills covering authoring/debugging/safe-outputs

features.delta: Both offer skill packs; gh-aw has richer coverage.
